results.title: Two Pids
results.overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

results.title: Rhodong Koi
results.overview: The story of Syamsul, a village badminton legend who was talented since childhood and trained to participate in badminton player selection. However, his dream is thwarted when he and his coach are involved in an accident on the way to the selection session. Syamsul eventually builds success as a catfish entrepreneur.

results.title: To Your Island
results.overview: A paper crane from his ex-boyfriend, a fantasy island composed of his memory, a rabbit with amnesia, some are covered, traces of separation and love. The film is adapted from the Jinjiang Literature City novel "To Your Island".

results.title: Hotspot 2 Much
results.overview: The film is about an aspiring Director, who pitches her three different stories, that depict some pressing ideological and social issues in the society, to a producer with whom she also has an hidden agenda.

results.title: The End of It
results.overview: In a near-future world where ageing can be cured and death is now optional, Claire, a former provocative artist approaching her 250th birthday, decides she’s had enough, she wants to die.

results.title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
results.overview: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

results.title: Amityvillenado
results.overview: In the wake of a devastating storm that destroys the infamous DeFeo house, a paranormal entity merges with a malevolent tornado, unleashing an otherworldly force upon the town of Amityville.

results.title: Friends Like Us
results.overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

results.title: È un mondo difficile
results.overview: Elena and Francesco are bound by a love full of ups and downs, a visceral bond that spans the years, the distances, and diverging life choices. As their paths seem to drift apart, something keeps pulling them back to each other. He finds a new balance with Marta, while she becomes involved with Arthur, who offers her stability and a marriage proposal. But with her wedding just around the corner, the only choice left is the one they’ve never had the courage to make.

results.title: The Baby Clause
results.overview: A career driven woman fixated on become a single mom finds herself with more family and loves than she ever thought possible when a precocious preteen plays matchmaker with her jaded single dad.

results.title: Didn't Die
results.overview: A podcast host desperately clings to an ever-shrinking audience in the zombie apocalypse.

results.title: Pus$y Catz
results.overview: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future.

results.title: Between Brothers
results.overview: In this intimate family portrait, documentary filmmaker Tom Fassaert observes the relationship between his father Rob (72) and his older brother René (75). What begins as a tragicomic film about their unusual dynamic – one was a psychologist for many years, the other a psychiatric patient – turns into a moving search for their unknown roots.

results.title: Ancient Underwater Marvels: Evidence of Atlantis
results.original_title: Ancient Underwater Marvels: Evidence of Atlantis
results.overview: By examining cutting edge sonar technology, expert analysis and a relentless pursuit of truth, scientists strip away the layers of speculation surrounding Atlantis

results.title: Una directora Extraordinaria
results.overview: In December 2018, Mónica, the principal of the Pehuajó National College, hands over the keys to the high school so the bathrooms can be renovated. The work is delayed, and classes begin with portable toilets. One day, the architect disappears. Mónica must fight against bureaucracy and maintain order at the school. The students will join her in her struggle. The film is inspired by a true story.

results.title: Looking at Madness
results.overview: A theatre actress in Chicago struggles due to the pressures of her career goals and deteriorating mental health.

results.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
results.overview: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

results.title: Unscripted Love
results.overview: After yet another disastrous date, a hopeless romantic tries to find love by reenacting famous movie  moments only to discover that the best love stories aren’t scripted.

results.title: Banned from Broadcast: My Three Wives
results.original_title: 放送禁止 ぼくの3人の妻
results.overview: The Banned from Broadcast series is depicted under the premise that VTR footage that was originally canceled from broadcast due to certain circumstances is re-edited and aired. In this new episode, polygamy is the central theme. The story follows one man and his three wives, and through the recorded VTR footage, it ultimately reveals which of the wives murdered the man.
